name: CubeShooter
blurb: Just move around your mouse or you can use your keyboard, just click to toggle between mouse and keyboard control.
description:
Just move around your mouse or you can use your keyboard, just click to toggle between mouse and keyboard control.

When not in mouse mode just use the keyboard arrow keys to move and spacebar to shoot. Press 'R' to reset the game.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
